svg.title: Maxime Boulle — Full-Stack & DevOps Engineer
svg.desc: Maxime Boulle, Full-Stack and DevOps Engineer based in Paris. React, Java and Maven, Ansible, Terraform and Proxmox. CKAD certified. Permanent contract. Open to opportunities.
svg.metadata: Typefaces: Inter Tight, Inter, Space Mono — SIL Open Font License 1.1. Built with intent, Paris, 2026.
svg.text: I build full-stack systems end to end —
Based in Paris. React on the front, Java and Maven on the back,
Ansible, Terraform and Proxmox on the platform. CKAD certified.
React interfaces, Java APIs, and the glue
in between. I ship features end to end,
that doesn't depend on someone's laptop.
Secure by default, observable in production.
I design for failure before it happens.
REST and gRPC services with boundaries
that stay understandable as the system grows.
